scene: A blade has curled one word off the label. It used to say “usually”. The edge is still soft enough to take a print.

paths.action: Tilt the label and take the impression
paths.result: You find the tail of a letter under the smooth wax. The next reader can feel exactly where the surface changed.

paths.action: Ask the night worker for a fresh wording
paths.result: The worker remembers the exception but hesitates over the word. Two versions leave with their names attached.

scene: The binding opens flat at an empty stitch. A leaf riding under the blotter would have fallen exactly there.

paths.action: Count the holes against the loose leaf
paths.result: The three holes match. You can show where the leaf fitted even though the ink has run.

paths.action: Invite the binder to read the leaf aloud
paths.result: The binder recognises the odd date. A reader who cannot see the holes can now ask about it.

scene: Somebody moved the awkward slip into a drawer for broken handles. The keeper of that drawer knows why it stayed dry.

paths.action: Cut a second index tab
paths.result: Two drawers now point to the same dry slip. A visitor can find it by its case name.

paths.action: Hold the reading beside the hiding place
paths.result: The handle keeper opens the drawer for the next shift. Visitors learn where it went, and he loses his quiet minute.

scene: Two streets repeat a notice in different words. Each swears the other street must have stopped listening.

paths.action: Trade the posted copies across the corner
paths.result: When the houses swap slips the difference travels with the paper. Each street now holds the other's wording.

paths.action: Have two runners listen at the same corner
paths.result: The runners agree on what they heard there. Both routes still need a reading at the far end.

scene: A meeting room has been locked for the afternoon. One worker hopes to avoid another crowded, bitter hearing. Two sisters have arrived by different doors.

paths.action: Set a shared table on the threshold
paths.result: The sisters can set their slips side by side. People in the queue can see the exchange.

paths.action: Walk a covered notebook between the doors
paths.result: Each sister can answer in private. A returning reader has to trust the carrier with the pause between their words.

scene: Two witness groups have separate appointments. A pencilled circle on the rota is the only moment their shifts overlap.

paths.action: Borrow the last five minutes of both shifts
paths.result: One person from each crew meets at the bell. The rest must rely on those two to carry the reply.

paths.action: Exchange the two marked calendars
paths.result: Both crews discover the missing overlap. They keep their separate appointments and can leave a question for each other.

scene: The form has one slot where two quite different descriptions once fitted. The clerk who shortened it can finish a whole queue before lunch.

paths.action: Hinge a second strip beside the slot
paths.result: The fast form survives. A reader can lift the hinge to see the description that would have been lost.

paths.action: Run one unusual parcel through the old form
paths.result: The clerk has to wait for a second term. The parcel gets a fuller account and the queue loses a few minutes.

scene: A maker's name for the piece has been rubbed off the shelf. The trader's new name fits the same stock number.

paths.action: Ask the maker to mark a removable tie
paths.result: The stock room can keep its number. The tie carries the maker's term, and the maker decides when to remove it.

paths.action: Mark where the two names are actually used
paths.result: A trading slip and a workshop slip leave together. The next keeper can follow either name back to a place.

scene: A bundle of local readings is stamped “noise”. The clerk saved them, folded small, in case a second instrument arrived.

paths.action: Read one local slip beside the gauge
paths.result: The slip and gauge agree for one setting and part again at another. The conditions travel with the difference.

paths.action: Give the local keeper a turn at the dial
paths.result: The keeper reproduces the old mark. The clerk sees which surface the original reading depended on.

scene: A well-known face hangs above an unsigned claim. People gather under the portrait while the maker of the test clears up alone.

paths.action: Slide the portrait beside the maker's trace
paths.result: Visitors can still see the familiar face. Their eyes now follow a scored strip down to the person who made it.

paths.action: Ask whose hand actually tried the claim
paths.result: A quiet worker lifts a stained thumb. The celebrity keeps the poster and agrees to point the next visitor their way.

scene: A witness has begun to mistrust the mark they saw. The clean public copy has been before their eyes all morning.

paths.action: Let the witness revisit their old sightline
paths.result: The mark is visible from the low step for one short moment. The witness puts a place and time beside it.

paths.action: Seal an account before showing the copy
paths.result: Two accounts now exist. A disagreement is visible without asking the witness to keep defending a memory in public.

scene: A witness glows after a generous introduction and starts to describe a room they never entered. The audience would like them to go on.

paths.action: Give the witness a place to stop
paths.result: They end at the threshold. The last two lines now belong to a second speaker who stood inside.

paths.action: Ask for the handoff between the two speakers
paths.result: The witness names the person who supplied the ending. The listener can follow the chain and the witness keeps their dignity.

scene: A brilliant seal spans two clauses. The press tested the first one. A traveller about to leave is already pointing at the second.

paths.action: Cut a window round the tested clause
paths.result: The gold stays where the press made a test. A traveller can see daylight round the rest.

paths.action: Ask the traveller to repeat the second test
paths.result: The traveller can confirm one extra condition. The seal still needs a note about the other conditions.

scene: A folded certificate says the inspection has finished. Nobody has yet unwrapped the object, and the person waiting has the last ferry to catch.

paths.action: Stamp the time of the first inspection
paths.result: The courier goes with a definite time and an unfinished certificate. The next desk knows where to begin.

paths.action: Send a removable tag for the next inspector
paths.result: The courier keeps the object moving. The tag can only be taken off by someone who opens the wrapping.

scene: A stall sells an answer at two prices. The cheaper slip leaves off what the dearer one promises to explain. The buyer can afford one slip.

paths.action: Put both versions on the reading rail
paths.result: Anyone can now compare the two promises. A porter gives up the rail for the last part of the shift.

paths.action: Let the buyer try the paid promise once
paths.result: The buyer takes one marked trial back to the stall. The next visitor sees what that money actually bought.
